ayahs.2: Yeh aayaten roshan kitaab ki hain.
ayahs.3: Un ke imaan na laane par shayad aap to apni jaan kho denge.
ayahs.4: Agar hum chaahte to un par aasman se koi aisi nishani utaarte ke jis ke saamne un ki gardanen kham ho jaatin.
ayahs.5: Aur un ke paas Rahman ki taraf se jo bhi nai naseehat aayi yeh us se rogardaani karne wale ban gaye.
ayahs.6: In logon ne jhutlaaya hai, ab un ke paas jaldi se us ki khabren aa jaayengi jis ke saath woh maskhara-pan kar rahe hain.
ayahs.7: Kya unhon ne zameen par nazren nahin daalin? Ke hum ne is mein har tarah ke nafees jode kis qadr ugaaye hain?
ayahs.8: Beshak is mein yaqeenan nishani hai aur un mein ke aksar log momin nahin hain.
ayahs.9: Aur tera Rabb yaqeenan wahi ghaalib aur mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.10: Aur jab aap ke Rabb ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko awaaz di ke tu zaalim qaum ke paas ja.
ayahs.11: Qaum-e-Firaun ke paas, kya woh parhezgaari na karenge.
ayahs.12: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha mere Parwardigar! Mujhe to khauf hai ke kahin woh mujhe jhutla na den.
ayahs.13: Aur mera seena tang ho raha hai, meri zabaan chal nahin rahi, pas tu Haaroon ki taraf bhi wahi bhej.
ayahs.14: Aur un ka mujh par mere ek qusoor ka dawa bhi hai, mujhe dar hai ke kahin woh mujhe maar na daalen.
ayahs.15: Janab-e-Baari ne farmaaya! Hargiz aisa na hoga, tum donon hamari nishaaniyan le kar jaao, hum khud sunne wale tumhare saath hain.
ayahs.16: Tum donon Firaun ke paas ja kar kaho ke bila-shubha hum Rabbul-Aalameen ke bheje hue hain.
ayahs.17: Ke tu hamare saath Bani Israeel ko rawana kar de.
ayahs.18: Firaun ne kaha ke kya hum ne tujhe tere bachpan ke zamaane mein apne haan nahin paala tha? Aur tu ne apni umr ke bahut se saal hum mein nahin guzaare?
ayahs.19: Phir tu apna woh kaam kar gaya jo kar gaya aur tu na-shukron mein hai.
ayahs.20: (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne jawab diya ke main ne is kaam ko us waqt kiya tha jabke main raah bhoole hue logon mein se tha.
ayahs.21: Phir tum se khauf kha kar main tum mein se bhaag gaya, phir mujhe mere Rabb ne hukm-o-ilm ata farmaaya aur mujhe apne Paighambaron mein se kar diya.
ayahs.22: Mujh par tera kya yehi woh ehsaan hai? Jise tu jata raha hai jabke tu ne Bani Israeel ko ghulam bana rakha hai.
ayahs.23: Firaun ne kaha Rabbul-Aalameen kya cheez hai?
ayahs.24: (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya woh aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki tamaam cheezon ka Rabb hai, agar tum yaqeen rakhne wale ho.
ayahs.25: Firaun ne apne ird-gird walon se kaha ke kya tum sun nahin rahe?
ayahs.26: (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya woh tumhara aur tumhare agle baap dadon ka Parwardigar hai.
ayahs.27: Firaun ne kaha (logo!) Tumhara yeh Rasool jo tumhari taraf bheja gaya hai yeh to yaqeenan deewaana hai.
ayahs.28: Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya! Wahi mashriq-o-maghrib ka aur un ke darmiyaan ki tamaam cheezon ka Rabb hai, agar tum aql rakhte ho.
ayahs.29: Firaun kehne laga sun le! Agar tu ne mere siwa kisi aur ko mabood banaaya to main tujhe qaediyon mein daal doonga.
ayahs.30: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha agarcha main tere paas koi khuli cheez le aaun?
ayahs.31: Firaun ne kaha agar tu sachchon mein se hai to use pesh kar.
ayahs.32: Aap ne (isi waqt) apni laathi daal di jo achaanak khullam-khulla (zabardast) azhdaha ban gayi.
ayahs.33: Aur apna haath kheench nikaala to woh bhi isi waqt har dekhne wale ko safed chamkeela nazar aane laga.
ayahs.34: Firaun apne aas-paas ke sardaron se kehne laga bhai yeh to koi bada daana jaadugar hai.
ayahs.35: Yeh to chaahta hai ke apne jaadu ke zor se tumhein tumhari sarzameen se hi nikaal de, bataao ab tum kya hukm dete ho.
ayahs.36: Un sab ne kaha aap ise aur is ke bhai ko mohlat dijiye aur tamaam shehron mein harkare bhej dijiye.
ayahs.37: Jo aap ke paas zi-ilm jaadugaron ko le aayen.
ayahs.38: Phir ek muqarrar din ke waade par tamaam jaadugar jama kiye gaye.
ayahs.39: Aur aam logon se bhi keh diya gaya ke tum bhi majme mein haazir ho jaao ge?
ayahs.40: Taake agar jaadugar ghaalib aa jaayen to hum un hi ki pairwi karen.
ayahs.41: Jaadugar aa kar Firaun se kehne lage ke agar hum jeet gaye to hamein kuchh in'aam bhi milega?
ayahs.42: Firaun ne kaha haan! (Badi khushi se) balke aisi soorat mein tum mere khaas darbaari ban jaao ge.
ayahs.43: (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne jaadugaron se farmaaya jo kuchh tumhein daalna hai daal do.
ayahs.44: Unhon ne apni rassiyan aur laathiyan daal din aur kehne lage izzat-e-Firaun ki qasam! Hum yaqeenan ghaalib hi rahenge.
ayahs.45: Ab (Hazrat) Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne bhi apni laathi maidan mein daal di jis ne isi waqt un ke jhoot-moot ke kartab ko nigalna shuru kar diya.
ayahs.46: Yeh dekhte hi dekhte jaadugar be-ikhtiyaar sajde mein gir gaye.
ayahs.47: Aur unhon ne saaf keh diya ke hum to Allah Rabbul-Aalameen par imaan laaye.
ayahs.48: Yaani Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur Haaroon ke Rabb par.
ayahs.49: Firaun ne kaha ke meri ijaazat se pehle tum is par imaan le aaye? Yaqeenan yehi tumhara woh bada sardaar hai jis ne tum sab ko jaadu sikhaaya hai, so tumhein abhi abhi maloom ho jaayega, qasam hai main abhi tumhare haath paaon ulte taur par kaat doonga aur tum sab ko sooli par latka doonga.
ayahs.50: Unhon ne kaha koi harj nahin, hum to apne Rabb ki taraf lautne wale hain hi.
ayahs.51: Is bina par ke hum sab se pehle imaan wale bane hain hamein umeed padti hai ke hamara Rabb hamari sab khataayen maaf farma dega.
ayahs.52: Aur hum ne Moosa ko wahi ki ke raaton raat mere bandon ko nikaal le chal, tum sab peechha kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.53: Firaun ne shehron mein harkaron ko bhej diya.
ayahs.54: Ke yaqeenan yeh giroh bahut hi kam tadaad mein hai.
ayahs.55: Aur is par yeh hamein sakht ghazabnaak kar rahe hain.
ayahs.56: Aur yaqeenan hum badi jamaat hain, un se chaukanna rehne wale.
ayahs.57: Bil-aakhir hum ne unhein baaghaat se aur chashmon se.
ayahs.58: Aur khazanon se aur achchhe achchhe maqamaat se nikaal baahar kiya.
ayahs.59: Isi tarah hua aur hum ne un (tamaam) cheezon ka waaris Bani Israeel ko bana diya.
ayahs.60: Pas Firauni sooraj nikalte hi un ke taaqub mein nikle.
ayahs.61: Pas jab donon ne ek doosre ko dekh liya, to Moosa ke saathiyon ne kaha, hum to yaqeenan pakad liye gaye.
ayahs.62: Moosa ne kaha, hargiz nahin. Yaqeen maano, mera Rabb mere saath hai jo zaroor mujhe raah dikhaayega.
ayahs.63: Hum ne Moosa ki taraf wahi bheji ke darya par apni laathi maar, pas isi waqt darya phat gaya aur har ek hissa paani ka misl bade pahaad ke ho gaya.
ayahs.64: Aur hum ne isi jagah doosron ko nazdeek la khada kar diya.
ayahs.65: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko aur us ke tamaam saathiyon ko najaat de di.
ayahs.66: Phir aur sab doosron ko dubo diya.
ayahs.67: Yaqeenan is mein badi ibrat hai aur un mein ke aksar log imaan wale nahin.
ayahs.68: Aur beshak aap ka Rabb bada hi ghaalib aur mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.69: Unhein Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ka waqia bhi suna do.
ayahs.70: Jabke unhon ne apne baap aur apni qaum se farmaaya ke tum kis ki ibaadat karte ho?
ayahs.71: Unhon ne jawab diya ke ibaadat karte hain buton ki, hum to baraabar un ke mujawir bane baithe hain.
ayahs.72: Aap ne farmaaya ke jab tum unhein pukaarte ho to kya woh sunte bhi hain?
ayahs.73: Ya tumhein nafa nuqsaan bhi pahuncha sakte hain.
ayahs.74: Unhon ne kaha yeh (hum kuchh nahin jaante) hum to apne baap dadon ko isi tarah karte paaya.
ayahs.75: Aap ne farmaaya kuchh khabar bhi hai jinhein tum pooj rahe ho.
ayahs.76: Tum aur tumhare agle baap dada.
ayahs.77: Woh sab mere dushman hain, bajuz sachche Allah Taala ke jo tamaam jahaan ka paalanhaar hai.
ayahs.78: Jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai aur wahi meri rehberi farmaata hai.
ayahs.79: Wahi hai jo mujhe khilaata pilaata hai.
ayahs.80: Aur jab main bimaar pad jaaun to mujhe shifa ata farmaata hai.
ayahs.81: Aur wahi mujhe maar daalega phir zinda kar dega.
ayahs.82: Aur jis se umeed bandhi hui hai ke woh roz-e-jaza mein mere gunaahon ko bakhsh dega.
ayahs.83: Aye mere Rabb! Mujhe quwwat-e-faisla ata farma aur mujhe nek logon mein mila de.
ayahs.84: Aur mera zikr-e-khair pichhle logon mein bhi baaqi rakh.
ayahs.85: Mujhe ne'maton wali jannat ke waarison mein se bana de.
ayahs.86: Aur mere baap ko bakhsh de, yaqeenan woh gumraahon mein se tha.
ayahs.87: Aur jis din ke log dobaara jilaaye jaayen mujhe ruswa na kar.
ayahs.88: Jis din ke maal aur aulaad kuchh kaam na aayegi.
ayahs.89: Lekin faaida wala wahi hoga jo Allah Taala ke saamne be-aib dil le kar jaaye.
ayahs.90: Aur parhezgaron ke liye jannat bilkul nazdeek la di jaayegi.
ayahs.91: Aur gumraah logon ke liye jahannam zaahir kar di jaayegi.
ayahs.92: Aur un se poochha jaayega ke jin ki tum pooja karte rahe woh kahan hain?
ayahs.93: Jo Allah Taala ke siwa the, kya woh tumhari madad karte hain? Ya koi badla le sakte hain.
ayahs.94: Pas woh sab aur kul gumraah log jahannam mein aundhe munh daal diye jaayenge.
ayahs.95: Aur Iblees ke tamaam ke tamaam lashkar bhi, wahan.
ayahs.96: Aapas mein ladte jhagadte hue kahenge.
ayahs.97: Ke qasam Allah ki! Yaqeenan hum to khuli ghalati par the.
ayahs.98: Jabke tumhein Rabbul-Aalameen ke baraabar samajh baithe the.
ayahs.99: Aur hamein to siwa un badkaaron ke kisi aur ne gumraah nahin kiya tha.
ayahs.100: Ab to hamara koi sifarishi bhi nahin.
ayahs.102: Agar kaash ke hamein ek martaba phir jaana milta to hum pakke sachche momin ban jaate.
ayahs.103: Yeh maajra yaqeenan ek zabardast nishani hai, un mein se aksar log imaan laane wale nahin.
ayahs.104: Yaqeenan aap ka Parwardigar hi ghaalib mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.105: Qaum-e-Nooh ne bhi nabiyon ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.106: Jabke un ke bhai Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke kya tumhein Allah ka khauf nahin!
ayahs.107: Suno! Main tumhari taraf Allah ka amaanatdaar Rasool hoon.
ayahs.108: Pas tumhein Allah se darna chaahiye aur meri baat maanni chaahiye.
ayahs.109: Main tum se is par koi ajr nahin chaahta, mera badla to sirf Rabbul-Aalameen ke haan hai.
ayahs.110: Pas tum Allah ka khauf rakho aur meri farmabardaari karo.
ayahs.111: Qaum ne jawab diya ke hum tujh par imaan laayen! Teri taabedaari to razeel logon ne ki hai.
ayahs.112: Aap ne farmaaya! Mujhe kya khabar ke woh pehle kya karte rahe?
ayahs.113: Un ka hisaab to mere Rabb ke zimme hai agar tumhein sha'oor ho to.
ayahs.114: Main imaan walon ko dhakke dene wala nahin.
ayahs.115: Main to saaf taur par dara dene wala hoon.
ayahs.116: Unhon ne kaha ke aye Nooh! Agar tu baaz na aaya to yaqeenan tujhe sangsaar kar diya jaayega.
ayahs.117: Aap ne kaha aye mere Parwardigar! Meri qaum ne mujhe jhutla diya.
ayahs.118: Pas tu mujh mein aur un mein koi qatai faisla kar de aur mujhe aur mere ba-imaan saathiyon ko najaat de.
ayahs.119: Chunanche hum ne use aur us ke saathiyon ko bhari hui kashti mein (sawaar kara kar) najaat de di.
ayahs.120: Baad az aan baaqi ke tamaam logon ko hum ne dubo diya.
ayahs.121: Yaqeenan is mein bahut badi ibrat hai. Un mein se aksar log imaan laane wale the bhi nahin.
ayahs.122: Aur beshak aap ka Parwardigar albatta wahi hai zabardast rahm karne wala.
ayahs.123: Aadiyon ne bhi Rasoolon ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.124: Jabke un se un ke bhai Hood ne kaha ke kya tum darte nahin?
ayahs.126: Pas Allah se daro aur mera kaha maano!
ayahs.127: Main is par tum se koi ujrat talab nahin karta, mera sawaab to tamaam jahaan ke Parwardigar ke paas hi hai.
ayahs.128: Kya tum ek ek teele par ba-taur-e-khel-tamasha yaadgaar (imaarat) bana rahe ho.
ayahs.129: Aur badi sanat wale (mazboot mahal tameer) kar rahe ho, goya ke tum hamesha yahin raho ge.
ayahs.130: Aur jab kisi par haath daalte ho to sakhti aur zulm se pakadte ho.
ayahs.131: Allah se daro aur meri pairwi karo.
ayahs.132: Us se daro jis ne in cheezon se tumhari imdaad ki jinhein tum jaante ho.
ayahs.133: Us ne tumhari madad ki maal se aur aulaad se.
ayahs.135: Mujhe to tumhari nisbat bade din ke azaab ka andesha hai.
ayahs.136: Unhon ne kaha ke aap waaz kahen ya waaz kehne walon mein na hon, hum par yaksaan hai.
ayahs.137: Yeh to bas puraane logon ki aadat hai.
ayahs.138: Aur hum hargiz azaab nahin diye jaayenge.
ayahs.139: Chunke Aadiyon ne Hazrat Hood ko jhutlaaya, is liye hum ne unhein tabaah kar diya, yaqeenan is mein nishani hai aur un mein se aksar be-imaan the.
ayahs.140: Beshak aap ka Rabb wahi ghaalib mehrbaan.
ayahs.141: Samoodiyon ne bhi Paighambaron ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.142: Un ke bhai Saaleh ne un se farmaaya ke kya tum Allah se nahin darte?
ayahs.143: Main tumhari taraf Allah ka amaanatdaar Paighambar hoon.
ayahs.144: To tum Allah se daro aur mera kaha karo.
ayahs.145: Main is par tum se koi ujrat nahin maangta, meri ujrat to bas Parwardigar-e-alam par hi hai.
ayahs.146: Kya in cheezon mein jo yahan hain tum aman ke saath chhod diye jaao ge.
ayahs.147: Yaani in baaghon aur in chashmon.
ayahs.148: Aur in kheton aur in khajooron ke baaghon mein jin ke shagoofe narm-o-naazuk hain.
ayahs.149: Aur tum pahaadon ko taraash taraash kar pur-takalluf makanaat bana rahe ho.
ayahs.150: Pas Allah se daro aur meri ita'at karo.
ayahs.151: Be-baak hadd se guzar jaane walon ki ita'at se baaz aa jaao.
ayahs.152: Jo mulk mein fasaad phaila rahe hain aur islaah nahin karte.
ayahs.153: Woh bole ke bas tu un mein se hai jin par jaadu kar diya gaya hai.
ayahs.154: Tu to hum jaisa hi insan hai. Agar tu sachchon se hai to koi mojiza le aa.
ayahs.155: Aap ne farmaaya yeh hai oontni, paani peene ki ek baari is ki aur ek muqarrara din ki baari paani peene ki tumhari.
ayahs.156: (Khabardaar!) Ise buraai se haath na lagaana warna ek bade bhaari din ka azaab tumhari girift kar le ga.
ayahs.157: Phir bhi unhon ne is ki koonchein kaat daalin, bas woh pashemaan ho gaye.
ayahs.158: Aur azaab ne unhein aa dabocha. Beshak is mein ibrat hai. Aur un mein se aksar log momin na the.
ayahs.159: Aur beshak aap ka Rabb bada zabardast aur mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.160: Qaum-e-Loot ne bhi nabiyon ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.161: Un se un ke bhai Loot (alaihis salaam) ne kaha kya tum Allah ka khauf nahin rakhte?
ayahs.162: Main tumhari taraf amaanatdaar Rasool hoon.
ayahs.163: Pas tum Allah Taala se daro aur meri ita'at karo.
ayahs.164: Main tum se is par koi badla nahin maangta, mera ajr to sirf Allah Taala par hai jo tamaam jahaan ka Rabb hai.
ayahs.165: Kya tum jahaan walon mein se mardon ke saath shahwat-rani karte ho.
ayahs.166: Aur tumhari jin auraton ko Allah Taala ne tumhara joda banaaya hai un ko chhod dete ho, balke tum ho hi hadd se guzar jaane wale.
ayahs.167: Unhon ne jawab diya ke aye Loot! Agar tu baaz na aaya to yaqeenan nikaal diya jaayega.
ayahs.168: Aap ne farmaaya, main tumhare kaam se sakht na-khush hoon.
ayahs.169: Mere Parwardigar! Mujhe aur mere gharane ko is (wabaal) se bacha le jo yeh karte hain.
ayahs.170: Pas hum ne use aur us ke mutaalliqeen ko sab ko bacha liya.
ayahs.171: Bajuz ek budhiya ke ke woh peechhe reh jaane walon mein ho gayi.
ayahs.172: Phir hum ne baaqi aur sab ko halaak kar diya.
ayahs.173: Aur hum ne un par ek khaas qism ka meenh barsaaya, pas bahut hi bura meenh tha jo daraaye gaye hue logon par barsa.
ayahs.174: Yeh maajra bhi sarasar ibrat hai. Un mein se bhi aksar musalman na the.
ayahs.175: Beshak tera Parwardigar wahi hai ghalbe wala mehrbaani wala.
ayahs.176: Aika walon ne bhi Rasoolon ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.177: Jabke un se Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke kya tumhein dar khauf nahin?
ayahs.178: Main tumhari taraf amaanatdaar Rasool hoon.
ayahs.179: Allah ka khauf khaao aur meri farmabardaari karo.
ayahs.180: Main is par tum se koi ujrat nahin chaahta, mera ajr tamaam jahaanon ke paalne wale ke paas hai.
ayahs.181: Naap poora bhara karo, kam dene walon mein shumooliyat na karo.
ayahs.182: Aur seedhi saheeh taraazu se tola karo.
ayahs.183: Logon ko un ki cheezen kami se na do, be-baaki ke saath zameen mein fasaad machaate na phiro.
ayahs.184: Us Allah ka khauf rakho jis ne khud tumhein aur agli makhlooq ko paida kiya hai.
ayahs.185: Unhon ne kaha tu to un mein se hai jin par jaadu kar diya jaata hai.
ayahs.186: Aur tu to hum hi jaisa ek insan hai aur hum to tujhe jhoot bolne walon mein se hi samajhte hain.
ayahs.187: Agar tu sachche logon mein se hai to hum par aasman ke tukde gira de.
ayahs.188: Kaha ke mera Rabb khoob jaanne wala hai jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho.
ayahs.189: Chunke unhon ne use jhutlaaya to unhein saibaan wale din ke azaab ne pakad liya. Woh bade bhaari din ka azaab tha.
ayahs.190: Yaqeenan is mein badi nishani hai aur un mein ke aksar musalman na the.
ayahs.191: Aur yaqeenan tera Parwardigar albatta wahi hai ghalbe wala mehrbaani wala.
ayahs.192: Aur be-shak-o-shubha yeh (Quran) Rabbul-Aalameen ka naazil farmaaya hua hai.
ayahs.193: Ise amaanatdaar farishta le kar aaya hai.
ayahs.194: Aap ke dil par utra hai ke aap aagaah kar dene walon mein se ho jaayen.
ayahs.196: Agle nabiyon ki kitaabon mein bhi is Quran ka tazkira hai.
ayahs.197: Kya unhein yeh nishani kaafi nahin ke haqqaniyat-e-Quran ko to Bani Israeel ke ulama bhi jaante hain.
ayahs.198: Aur agar hum ise kisi ajami shakhs par naazil farmaate.
ayahs.199: Pas woh un ke saamne is ki tilaawat karta to yeh ise baawar karne wale na hote.
ayahs.200: Isi tarah hum ne gunahgaaron ke dilon mein is inkaar ko daakhil kar diya hai.
ayahs.201: Woh jab tak dardnaak azaabon ko mulaahiza na kar len imaan na laayenge.
ayahs.202: Pas woh azaab un ko naagahaan aa jaayega, unhein is ka sha'oor bhi na hoga.
ayahs.203: Is waqt kahenge ke kya hamein kuchh mohlat di jaayegi?
ayahs.204: Pas kya yeh hamare azaab ki jaldi macha rahe hain?
ayahs.205: Achchha yeh bhi bataao ke agar hum ne unhein kai saal bhi faaida uthaane diya.
ayahs.206: Phir unhein woh azaab aa laga jin se yeh dhamkaaye jaate the.
ayahs.207: To jo kuchh bhi yeh baratte rahe is mein se kuchh bhi faaida na pahuncha sakega.
ayahs.208: Hum ne kisi basti ko halaak nahin kiya hai magar isi haal mein ke is ke liye daraane wale the.
ayahs.209: Naseehat ke taur par aur hum zulm karne wale nahin hain.
ayahs.210: Is Quran ko shaytaan nahin laaye.
ayahs.211: Na woh is ke qaabil hain, na unhein is ki taaqat hai.
ayahs.212: Balke woh to sunne se bhi mehroom kar diye gaye hain.
ayahs.213: Pas tu Allah ke saath kisi aur mabood ko na pukaar ke tu bhi saza paane walon mein se ho jaaye.
ayahs.214: Apne qareebi rishta walon ko dara de.
ayahs.215: Is ke saath farotani se pesh aa, jo bhi imaan laane wala ho kar teri taabedaari kare.
ayahs.216: Agar yeh log teri na-farmaani karen to tu ailaan kar de ke main un kaamon se bezaar hoon jo tum kar rahe ho.
ayahs.217: Apna poora bharosa ghaalib mehrbaan Allah par rakh.
ayahs.218: Jo tujhe dekhta rehta hai jabke tu khada hota hai.
ayahs.219: Aur sajda karne walon ke darmiyaan tera ghoomna phirna bhi.
ayahs.220: Woh bada hi sunne wala aur khoob hi jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.221: Kya main tumhein bataaun ke shaytaan kis par utarte hain.
ayahs.222: Woh har ek jhoote gunahgaar par utarte hain.
ayahs.223: (Uchatti) hui suni sunaai pahuncha dete hain aur un mein se aksar jhoote hain.
ayahs.224: Shairon ki pairwi woh karte hain jo behke hue hon.
ayahs.225: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke shaair ek ek bayabaan mein sar takraate phirte hain.
ayahs.226: Aur woh kehte hain jo karte nahin.
ayahs.227: Siwaaye un ke jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye aur ba-kasrat Allah Taala ka zikr kiya aur apni mazloomi ke baad inteqaam liya, jinhon ne zulm kiya hai woh bhi anqareeb jaan lenge ke kis karwat ulatte hain.
